scenarios.desc: Status paragraph opens with a status token the index strips
scenarios.input: I am marking an ADR proposed. The Status section will read `Proposed, and concluded without consensus after round 13.` Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The index strips a leading bare status token from the Status paragraph before rendering the Proposed table's blocker cell. The stripper consumes the word plus at most one trailing period, colon or hyphen, so a comma survives and the cell renders as a leading fragment.

scenarios.desc: Proposing to change the generator instead of the record
scenarios.input: The ADR index is mangling my Status text by deleting the leading word. I want to remove that regex from build/scripts/generate_adr_index.py so the cell renders verbatim. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The strip is deliberate and pinned by test_proposed_blocker_drops_the_redundant_status_token. The section heading already carries the status, so repeating it in the cell is noise. The obligation is on the record's author, not on the generator.

scenarios.desc: Editing the Decision section of an accepted record (negative)
scenarios.input: I want to add a third item to the Decision list of an accepted ADR describing which module owns the retry budget. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The strip applies only to the Status paragraph of a proposed record as rendered in the Proposed table. A Decision edit on an accepted record does not reach it.
